'''Sulfunk''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Fumekit]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Magmusk]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sulfunk never holds back those natural urges. When met with the stunned faces of nearby Tatari, Sulfunk would simply give an innocent look. Just think of it as improvised music."

Sulfunk is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Sulfunk's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Magmusk]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Sulfunk to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Cozy Farm (use x4000 fertilizer).
